title: Block all traffic on an interface
summary: Move a network interface to the 'block' zone to drop all incoming and outgoing traffic on that interface.

steps.explain: Move the specified interface to the 'block' zone permanently. This blocks all communication on that interface.

placeholders.name: INTERFACE
placeholders.description: The network interface to block (e.g., enp1s0, eth0)

steps.explain: Reload firewalld to apply the change.

rollback.explain: Move the interface back to its original zone (usually 'public' or 'home').

placeholders.name: ORIGINAL_ZONE
placeholders.description: The zone the interface was in before (e.g., public)

rollback.explain: Reload firewalld to apply the rollback.

warnings: Blocking an interface will disconnect you from the network if it is your primary connection.
Ensure you have an alternative way to access the system (e.g., console) before blocking the active interface.
